description: Deploy a new AgentAccountV2 wallet via the factory contract. The wallet is deterministically addressed (CREATE2) and owned by an NFT. Returns the wallet address and deployment transaction hash. Requires FACTORY_ADDRESS and NFT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS env vars (or pass them as arguments).

factory_address.description: Factory contract address. Defaults to FACTORY_ADDRESS env var.

nft_contract_address.description: NFT contract address. Defaults to NFT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS env var.

token_id.description: NFT token ID that will own this wallet (e.g. "1")

name: deploy_wallet
